function.name: LOAD_TTFAA
function.param: Depth of colour (it must be 8 or 16)
function.abstract: It recovers a type of Truetype letter of disk, creating an internal font from the desired size, with antialiasing.

description.p: This function recovers of disk a type of Truetype letter and creates internally the bitmaps of all characters in the standard game characters (ISO-8859-1). The fuction returns an identifier of font (or type of letter) that can be used in the callings to functions like or .

The indicated size is an orientative value. There will be characters whose final size will be a little superior to indicated. Too, the final size of character depends of type of letter, although to a same size, a lot of types of letter must have a comparable aspect.

This function creates a font to colour, using the parameter colour to draw the characters. The depth of colour can be of 8 or 16 bits, according to the parameter depth, and affects to the bitmaps of all characters.

As much the parameter "colour" as the parameter "background" indicate colours whose meaning depends of the current graph mode. In graph mode of 8 bits, the two parameters will indicate a colour of the palette (0 to 255). In opposite case, they are colour codes of 0 to 65535 whose meaning is according to the computer. It is recommended to use the function to obtain both parameters. This mode of working is equivalent to the rest of functions that require colours like parameters, like for example or .

In both cases, the edge of the font will be degraded by a technique called "antialiasing", using the colour specified in the parameter background. This technique improves the aspect of the font, when the text is drawn upon a surface where the colour indicated like background prevails. If you want to make other thing, you can use to create a font without antialiasing, or create a lot of versions of the same font using colours of different backgrounds (with an important cost in memory).

If you want, it is possible to save the resulting font with the function SAVE_FNT. A FNT archive is much more fast to load that a TTF font, but only holds the final font (the bitmaps of each character), while the archive TTF holds information to draw text to any resolution and size.

note.p: As much LOAD_TTF as LOAD_TTFA save information about last TTF archive recovered in memory, this allows to accelerate the following calls to the function that are made with the same font (always that those calls are consecutive). This can happen usually, for example if you want to use a type of Truetype letter to several sizes. However, it is recommended to use TTF archives of low size in disk, or to recover last smaller TTF archive at least.
